_why: Data for automatic source discovery (fr-sources 2026-10-22). `exclude_hosts`: hosts (and their subdomains) a candidate line never proposes — social networks and short links (the social line reads accounts instead), scholarly resolvers and registries (the journal line reads ISSNs), general news, newswires, shops and web infrastructure. `directories`: organisations a person listed as medical or health — regulators, public-health agencies, research institutes, hospitals, societies, medical media and companies' newsrooms; each is probed for a subscription feed by the directory line, and its listing here is the candidate's medical basis.
